name: Identity
tagline: An identity provider with synthetic people: OIDC and OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, password grant and Bot Framework.
point: http://localhost:8025/login/<tenant>/v2.0 (discovery, JWKS and token per environment)

capabilities.title: Four flavours of OIDC
capabilities.text: Entra ID v2, Google, Okta or generic OIDC: discovery, JWKS, authorize, token, userinfo and logout, with the provider's error codes.

capabilities.title: A sign-in page
capabilities.text: Stuntman serves the login page: a person, a test or an agent picks the simulated user, then MFA and consent follow.

capabilities.title: Synthetic people
capabilities.text: Users with tenant, groups, roles, MFA, guest, extra claims, locked or disabled. The next tokens carry the change.

capabilities.title: App registrations
capabilities.text: Web, SPA, daemon or API apps with exact redirect URIs, secrets, permissions, optional claims and admin consent.

capabilities.title: SAML 2.0 IdP
capabilities.text: Metadata, SSO by Redirect or POST, a signed assertion posted to the app's ACS; name ID from email, oid or upn.

capabilities.title: LDAP directory
capabilities.text: Simple bind, search, compare and whoami on :3389. Wrong passwords, locked and disabled accounts answer as Active Directory.

capabilities.title: Password grant
capabilities.text: grant_type=password with AADSTS50126 for a wrong password, AADSTS50076 for MFA and AADSTS50053 for a locked user.

capabilities.title: Bot Framework
capabilities.text: send_bot_activity posts a Teams message or card action to the bot, signed by the Bot Connector; replies land in list_bot_messages.

capabilities.title: OAuth client checks
capabilities.text: Stuntman acts as the client of the app's MCP server and runs ten authorization checks against it.

callouts.title: Pick who signs in
callouts.text: Each synthetic user with groups and MFA. Agents skip the page with sign_in_as.

callouts.title: Another tenant
callouts.text: A user from another tenant, for apps that must refuse or accept guests.

callouts.title: MFA, phone lost
callouts.text: A user whose MFA cannot complete, to test the app's error page.

callouts.title: What the app asked for
callouts.text: Client, redirect, scopes, prompt, PKCE and state, checked against the app registration.

callouts.title: Cancel
callouts.text: The person cancels: the app gets error=access_denied.

excerpts.title: Users and the claims they carry

callouts.title: Users
callouts.text: Synthetic people of the tenant: MFA, guest, another tenant, disabled.

callouts.title: Groups and roles
callouts.text: Set groups or a number of them: 210 groups takes the app down the overage path.

callouts.title: MFA required
callouts.text: The next sign-in asks for a code; provoke mfa_fails to make it fail.

callouts.title: The token
callouts.text: The ID token the app will get, with the claims of this user.

callouts.title: Revoke consent
callouts.text: The next sign-in asks again and refresh tokens stop working.

excerpts.title: Older protocols on the same users

callouts.title: SAML 2.0
callouts.text: Metadata, SSO and entity ID per tenant, with signed assertions (RSA-SHA256).

callouts.title: LDAP provocations
callouts.text: busy (51), unavailable (52) or timeout; normal stops it.

callouts.title: Password grant
callouts.text: Off by default; on, it answers with the provider's AADSTS errors.

callouts.title: Bot twists
callouts.text: Send an activity with a bad signature, expired, wrong audience or no token.

callouts.title: Send to the bot
callouts.text: Posts the activity to the bot's endpoint as Teams would, signed by the connector.

provoke.name: MFA required or failing
provoke.what: The next sign-ins ask for MFA, or the code fails

provoke.name: Wrong tenant
provoke.what: A user from another tenant signs in

provoke.name: Bad signature
provoke.what: Tokens or SAML assertions signed wrongly

provoke.name: IdP down
provoke.what: The sign-in fails because the provider is down

provoke.name: Discovery or JWKS broken
provoke.what: Discovery 500, wrong issuer, kid missing, token invalid_grant

provoke.name: Signing key rotated
provoke.what: Apps that cached the JWKS at start-up reject new tokens

provoke.name: Disabled user
provoke.what: Sign-ins stop with AADSTS50057; refresh tokens refused

advantages.title: No test tenant to manage
advantages.text: No Entra, Google or Okta tenant, no test accounts with real MFA, no admin to grant consent. Users are synthetic and made in one call.

advantages.title: Every edge case on demand
advantages.text: Expired tokens, rotated keys, group overage and cancelled logins, which a real tenant almost never shows you.

advantages.title: Agents can sign in
advantages.text: sign_in_as completes the login, MFA and consent, so a coding agent tests flows behind SSO without a person.

advantages.title: One directory, every protocol
advantages.text: OIDC, SAML, LDAP and the password grant answer for the same people, so legacy and new code paths are tested together.

agent.prompt: Check that the app handles an Entra key rotation without logging everyone out.
steps: 2 sign-ins · last token signed with the new key · JWKS fetched again
tools: Create a provider: flavour, tenant, SAML, LDAP, password grant

notes: LDAP uses one port for every environment: binds go to the default one.
